_comment: Greenhouse Controller simulation — optimised settings for general crops (moderate biomass + active soil + glazing).
_note: Changes vs firmware factory defaults: hyst_t 3→5, hyst_rh 5→8, avg_win_t 3→6, dwell_open M1/M2 120→300 s and M3 120→900 s (M3's 171 s travel makes it the dominant oscillation driver, so it gets a longer minimum-open hold), c_eff_mj_per_c 10→30 (general-crops thermal mass; lives in plant_general_crops.json).
